children: New Delhi, Sept. 16 -- A small-cap stock hit its upper circuit in morning trade on the BSE on Wednesday, 16 September, after the company announced a Rs.1,041.63 crore order win. Saatvik Green Energy share price jumped 10% to hit the upper circuit of Rs.428.60, a day after announcing an order from Solar Energy Corporation of India for Solar PV Modules, worth Rs.1,041.63 crore.

"We wish to inform you that Saatvik Green Energy Limited has been awarded and has accepted an order from Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited for the supply of Solar PV Modules, with an aggregate order value of Rs.1,041.63 crore," said the company in an exchange filing post-market hours on 15 September.
According to the company's exchange filing, the order will be executed by December 2027.
